channel.title: ARLing Notes
channel.description: Krátke a presné odpovede na chyby, ktoré vývojári a slovenskí účtovníci stále hľadajú. Každá poznámka končí nástrojom, ktorý to skontroluje.

item.title: Description text too short in Google Merchant Center: find the flagged products and every Shopify product with no description
item.description: Merchant Center lists the flagged products, and the Shopify product export finds every product with no description. Here is how, and what Google asks for.

item.title: Missing field "hasMerchantReturnPolicy" and "shippingDetails" on Shopify: what Search Console means and how to fix it
item.description: What the Missing field warnings for returns and shipping mean in Search Console, and three ways to give Google your Shopify return and shipping terms.

item.title: Limited performance due to missing identifiers [gtin, mpn, brand] on Shopify: what to fill in
item.description: Google's missing identifiers message on Shopify: where the GTIN, MPN and brand go, and what to do for handmade, custom and vintage products.

item.title: Koľko stojí webstránka v roku 2026 a za čo sa platí
item.description: Koľko stojí webstránka pre malú firmu v roku 2026: tvorba, doména, hosting, stavebnica, WordPress, Shoptet a správa. Ceny zo slovenských cenníkov s dátumom čítania.

item.title: Povinné údaje na webových stránkach: čo musí mať web živnostníka a s. r. o.
item.description: Aké údaje musí mať web živnostníka a s. r. o. podľa Obchodného zákonníka, zákona o elektronickom obchode a zákona o ochrane spotrebiteľa: kontrolný zoznam a paragrafy.

item.title: Rýchlosť webu na mobile: prečo sa načítava pomaly a ako ju zmerať zadarmo
item.description: Prečo sa web na mobile načítava pomaly a ako jeho rýchlosť zmerať zadarmo v PageSpeed Insights. Čo znamenajú LCP, INP a CLS a čo opravíte bez programátora.

item.title: Empty product type in Shopify: why it matters for AI shopping and how to fill it in bulk
item.description: 49 of 113 stores that Shopify features had at least one product without a product type. Why the field matters for AI shopping and how to fill it in bulk.

item.title: Shopify products not showing in ChatGPT: the Shopify Catalog requirements to check first
item.description: Why Shopify products don't appear in ChatGPT: where your admin shows Shopify Catalog status, the product requirements, and what robots.txt does not change.

item.title: Shopify seo.hidden metafield: how to find hidden products and make them visible again
item.description: How the seo.hidden metafield hides a Shopify product from search engines and Shopify Catalog, how to find hidden products in bulk, and how to undo it.

item.title: Zmerali sme rýchlosť 16 starších webov ubytovaní a autoservisov: dobré skóre na mobile majú len tri
item.description: Rýchlosť webu na mobile: 16 starších webov ubytovaní a autoservisov má v Lighthouse medián 61 zo 100, dobré skóre len tri. Metodika aj hranice vzorky.

item.title: Advent treasure hunt clues for kids: 24 hiding spots and a clue for every day
item.description: Advent treasure hunt clues for kids: a 24-day plan with hiding spots at child height, a clue for each day, rhymes and codes for older kids, and the routine.

item.title: A Christmas murder mystery without actors or roles: how to host one with friends
item.description: How to host a Christmas murder mystery for adults with no roles or scripts: a pencil and paper case for a group, a small case to try, and how to make one.

item.title: A custom crossword as a gift: how to choose the words and write the clues
item.description: How to make a custom crossword gift: picking 10 to 25 words, writing clues only they will get, and how long clues can be before they no longer fit the page.

item.title: AI is now "Super Intelligence" in US federal agencies: what the order requires
item.description: On 29 September 2026 a US executive order told federal agencies to use "Super Intelligence" and "SI" in place of "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI". What the order text requires, what it leaves alone, its one 60-day deadline, and how to change a document without rewriting law titles.

item.title: Dobropis a oprava základu dane: v ktorom období sa opravuje DPH
item.description: Kedy dobropis patrí do obdobia, keď ste ho vyhotovili, a kedy treba dodatočné priznanie za pôvodné obdobie. Zákon o DPH, príklady Finančnej správy, sadzba a náležitosti.

item.title: Faktúra e-mailom v roku 2026: stačí súhlas zaplatením?
item.description: Súhlas s faktúrou e-mailom môže byť aj jej zaplatenie, píše Finančná správa. Kedy je taká faktúra vyhotovená, výnimka roku 2026 a čo sa mení od 1. 1. 2027.

item.title: It does not have HTTP ok status: what the CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request needs
item.description: Why Chrome says the preflight does not have HTTP ok status, which server layer turns your OPTIONS request into a 401, 404, 405 or 500, and how to answer it with a 2xx.

item.title: Redirect is not allowed for a preflight request: CORS, redirects and the trailing slash
item.description: Why Chrome refuses a CORS preflight that gets a 3xx, how to find the redirect with one curl command, and the usual causes: a trailing slash, www, https or a login page.

item.title: Request header field is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers: fixing the preflight allow-list
item.description: Why the CORS preflight rejects a request header such as Authorization or Content-Type, how to read the full list the browser asked for, and how to fix Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

item.title: Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*' with credentials mode 'include': why cookies need an exact origin
item.description: Why browsers reject Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on requests with cookies, where the * comes from in Express or Laravel, and the two headers that fix it.

item.title: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: find the two rules redirecting to each other (Cloudflare, nginx, proxies, WordPress)
item.description: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS means two layers keep undoing each other's redirect. Read the loop with curl, then fix the Cloudflare, nginx, proxy or WordPress rule behind it.

item.title: "The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID": Sign In With Google and JavaScript origins
item.description: Google Identity Services logs this when the scheme, host and port of your page match no entry in Authorized JavaScript origins. The causes in order, and the fix for each.

item.title: JWT "invalid signature": wrong secret, wrong key, or the wrong algorithm
item.description: What JsonWebTokenError: invalid signature rules out, the four byte mismatches behind it, and how to prove which one you have before you change any code.

item.title: "jwt malformed": what your verifier received instead of a token
item.description: jsonwebtoken throws jwt malformed when the value does not split into three parts at the periods. What arrived instead of a token, and the fix for each case.

item.title: Set-Cookie blocked because of SameSite=Lax: fixing a session cookie from a cross-site API
item.description: Why Chrome drops a Set-Cookie without SameSite from a cross-site API response, how to tell cross-site from cross-origin, and the two routes that fix it.

item.title: Leitweg-ID fehlt (BR-DE-15): wo sie in die XRechnung gehört
item.description: Leitweg-ID fehlt, Fehler BR-DE-15: Die ID gehört in die Käuferreferenz BT-10 (cbc:BuyerReference). Wo sie herkommt, wie Sie die Datei korrigieren und was der KoSIT-Validator in unserem Test nicht prüfte.

item.title: Čo sa zmenilo vo FAQ k eFaktúre: verzia z 15. 9. 2026
item.description: FAQ Finančnej správy k eFaktúre z 15. 9. 2026 zmenilo jedinú odpoveď: správu bytov a spoločenstvo vlastníkov. Čo pribudlo 11. 9. 2026 a prehľad všetkých desiatich verzií roku 2026.

item.title: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present: which response is missing it, and the fix
item.description: Why the browser says No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present, and how to find whether the preflight, a redirect or an error response lacks it.

item.title: E-faktúra a neplatiteľ DPH
item.description: Elektronická faktúra sa od 1. januára 2027 nevzťahuje na každého podnikateľa rovnako: povinnosť vyhotoviť ju platí len pre tuzemského platiteľa DPH pri

item.title: EU-Sanktionsliste und OFAC: was prüft welches Werkzeug
item.description: Wer international handelt, hört neben der EU-Sanktionsliste schnell auch Begriffe wie OFAC, OFSI oder SECO, und die vier Namen stehen nicht für dasselbe.
